lines.text: Never uncover the mirror in a rented apartment.
My landlord had one rule: keep the hall mirror covered.
On day three, the sheet slipped off.
My reflection was there. The room behind it wasn't mine.
Gray walls. A wheelchair. Photos I'd never seen.
In every photo, it was me. Fifty years older.
Then the old man in the mirror waved at me.
I called my landlord. A phone rang inside the mirror.
The old man answered. With my voice.
He said: you'll never move out. I didn't.
So never uncover the mirror in a rented apartment.
